description: A native <table><caption> with no explicit aria-labelledby — the caption becomes a separate child node with role "caption", not folded into the table's own description field. Directly demonstrates the caption-folding gap noted in CONTEXTUALIZATION_PLAN.md: table.md's spec assumes <caption> "can end up in description", but that implicit association isn't implemented. Contrast with table-caption (which uses explicit aria-label and does populate description) and table-caption-role-aria (the same un-folded-caption behavior via role="caption")
